map.胎盘成熟度(Grannum分级)器 使用指南: Placental Maturity (Grannum Grade) Tool User Guide
map.根据B超胎盘影像特征(绒毛板、基底板、实质钙化)按Grannum 0–III级分: Grade by B-ultrasound placental features (chorionic plate, basal plate, parenchymal calcification) from Grannum 0-III
map.超声按胎盘钙化与基底板分级（0–III）。: Ultrasound grades by placental calcification and the basal plate (0-III).
map.识别胎盘过早老化（早产周出现 III 级）。: Identify premature placental ageing (grade III appearing before term).
map.结合胎龄评估胎盘功能。: Assess placental function together with gestational age.
map.：孕 30 周超声见 III 级胎盘（基底板融合、钙化明显）：早于 36 周出现: A grade III placenta on ultrasound at 30 weeks (fused basal plate, obvious calcification): grade III before 36 weeks indicates premature placental ageing and calls for stronger fetal heart and amniotic fluid monitoring.
map.：孕 34 周为 II 级、孕 38 周后为 III 级属正常成熟进程，反映胎盘: Grade II at 34 weeks and grade III after 38 weeks are part of the normal maturation process, reflecting placental ageing consistent with gestational age.
map.足月后 III 级正常；但若 <36 周出现提示过早老化，可能伴胎儿生长受限，需: Grade III at term is normal; but appearing before 36 weeks suggests premature ageing and may come with fetal growth restriction, so it needs combined assessment rather than reading the grade alone.
map.分级能判断胎盘功能吗？: Can the Grade Judge Placental Function?
map.分级仅反映形态成熟度，与功能并非完全对应；功能更靠脐血流、胎心监护与生物物理评分: The grade only reflects morphological maturity and does not fully correspond to function; function relies more on umbilical blood flow, fetal heart monitoring and the biophysical profile.
